name: Scarlet Palisade
summary: The Scarlet Palisade is a fortified redoubt held by the Scarlet Crusade in western Tirisfal Glades. Positioned just west of Solliden Farmstead, this encampment guards the nearby human farms against the Forsaken and any other non-human intruders.

sections.title: A Crusader Bulwark
sections.body: Erected along the rugged terrain west of Solliden Farmstead, the Scarlet Palisade serves as a forward defensive line for the Scarlet Crusade in Tirisfal Glades. Heavy wooden stakes, watchtowers, and constant patrols ring the encampment, maintaining a militant perimeter deep within territory claimed by the Forsaken. At the center of these fortifications stands the Crusader's Outpost, coordinating the zealots stationed here.

sections.title: Shielding the Farmstead
sections.body: The primary role of the Scarlet Palisade is securing the adjacent farmland and ensuring that the Crusade retains a foothold over vital agrarian lands in the glades. Scarlet warriors garrisoned at the palisade strike down any outsiders, undead or otherwise, who approach Solliden Farmstead, treating all non-humans as lethal threats to their holy mission.

faq.answer: The Scarlet Palisade is a heavily fortified Scarlet Crusade military encampment located west of Solliden Farmstead in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade stationed here?
faq.answer: Crusaders garrison the palisade to protect the adjacent Solliden Farmstead and maintain a secure enclave in Tirisfal Glades, attacking any non-humans who stray near.

faq.q: What building sits in the middle of the camp?
faq.answer: At the center of the camp stands the Crusader's Outpost, a fortified redoubt that anchors the palisade's defenses.

faq.q: Are the Crusaders hostile to the Alliance?
aliases: is scarlet crusade hostile to alliance
faq.answer: While originating from the human and dwarven defenders of Lordaeron, the Scarlet Crusade has degenerated into fanatical xenophobia. They view virtually all outsiders and non-humans with suspicion or open hostility.

angles.text: The Palisade represents an entrenched enemy stronghold right on the doorstep of the Undercity, manned by zealots dedicated to the total extermination of the Forsaken.
The fortified camp poses an immediate danger to traveling Horde scouts moving through western Tirisfal Glades.
